summary: Apply AI to project planning, monitoring, evaluation and coordination with practical human-review controls. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Applied AI in project management, monitoring and evaluation supports planning, reporting and evidence review for project teams. Project managers, M&E specialists and programme coordinators practise checking data readiness, drafting and validating plans, interpreting monitoring variances, and tracing evaluation findings to their sources. They also design human-review and risk controls for AI-assisted coordination, keeping project decisions accountable without requiring coding or model development.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage project delivery, results evidence or coordination workflows and want to apply AI without losing accountability for project decisions.
modules: Theory of Change and OECD DAC Evaluation
NIST AI RMF for Project Governance
Project AI Use Case and Reporting Plan
prerequisites: Practical experience in project management, monitoring and evaluation, programme coordination or a related project role is recommended. Basic spreadsheet skills are useful. No coding or programming is required.
